role: The vanilla client's frame pacer: converts wall-clock deltas into elapsedTicks and renderPartialTicks, syncing the high-resolution clock to the system clock.
scope_reason: Frame rate is not part of the game (SPEC: frames are drawn after a tick at partial tick 1.0 only when asked for; Minecraft.getSystemTime is tick * 50 in agent mode), so no timer drives the tick loop.

members.name: renderPartialTicks
members.note: agent-mode frames render at partial tick 1.0 by request, never from a timer

notes: The native player client (csrc/play/play.c) paces its loop with SDL timers and interpolates the same way, but no Timer port exists and none is gated; the human client's uncapped frames are cosmetic per SPEC.
